title: AgentHandoff
description: Standardized schema for structured state handoffs between Claude Code subagents.

taskId.description: Unique identifier of the task being executed.

status.description: Current status of the task execution.

modifiedPaths.description: List of files created or modified during the task.

testStatus.description: Status of the test verification suite.

nextSteps.description: Pending actions or next tasks for the receiving agent.

metadata.description: Additional context-specific properties passed to the next agent.
